segment.source: Renders the seals and standards the organisation holds as a row of marks, each linked to its certificate, with validity dates in the note. Use it for: quality and environmental standards at the end of a company page, audit seals on a services page, memberships closing a profile. Prefer 'Payment and Shipping Row' for transactional marks, and 'Funding Acknowledgement' for funders you must name rather than seals you hold.
